## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or contributors.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Relevant behavior has been checked; tests added where useful

For UI changes: include desktop/phone captures and note light/dark, keyboard and reduced-motion checks.
For catalog changes: link official facts, license and artwork sources.

## Related issue

Link an issue when relevant. Note migrations, limitations or follow-up work.
